observed: Plan implementable against current tree. 21s79: _read_store_build_meta (dashboard_lib:132) re-execs index_state_store whose import calls register_loaded_source -> ensure_runtime_current; bare except returns {} so _index_stats present=False and built_at falls back to index-build-stats.json (1606); IndexSection/GraphIndexSection branch only on present (dashboard.js 3857, 3938); IndexCompatibilityError carries .code/.component for a typed diagnostic. 21s7a: /api/dashboard handler (dashboard_server:949-953) already merges request-time watcher_health over the cached snapshot, so a request-time ensure_runtime_current field is a direct analogue and survives _rebuild returning None on stall (444-453), making AC-3 falsifiable. Red-team repair verified: uncached request-time check, no server_impl reuse, restart label only for index_runtime_stale (graph_snapshot._read_failure 248 gives restart for all three codes, so 21s79 must not reuse its text). Independent probe: after preload and a replaced _SOURCE_HASHES entry, ensure_runtime_current raises index_runtime_stale/chunker, the index_state_store re-exec raises the same, and _read_store_build_meta returns {} (AC-1 fails pre-fix); absent store under a current capture returns {} without raising (no-diagnostic control is realizable). Non-blocking text drift noted to coordinator.

Repair verified: 21s7a now checks uncached at /api/dashboard request time with the import inside the check, AC-3 is a stall-resilience oracle, no server_impl edit; 21s79 labels only index_runtime_stale as restart-required; both AC-2s require a rendered check. Fixtures are feasible with _seed_index_store/_write_dashboard_lance_index, DashboardWatcherHardeningTests' blocking_collect + _COLLECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS pattern, and _HandlerHarnessMixin. Rendered check (Q3) is feasible from a scratch copy of .wavefoundry/framework because _SOURCE_ROOT is derived from index_compatibility.__file__.
